Senior Backend Engineer — DeskZero Platform Team

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our core platform team. You will own
critical backend infrastructure powering our AI-driven HR screening product used by
hundreds of enterprise customers.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable Python/FastAPI microservices handling high-volume resume
  processing and AI scoring pipelines
- Architect and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and query performance for multi-tenant workloads
- Build and maintain async background worker systems (Redis Queue / ARQ) for processing
  thousands of resumes per day
- Integrate with Google Gemini LLM APIs (LangChain) for AI-powered analysis pipelines
- Lead technical design discussions and code reviews within a cross-functional team
- Mentor junior engineers and establish engineering best practices

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional backend software development experience
- Strong proficiency in Python (asyncio, type hints, Pydantic) — required
- Experience with FastAPI or similar async Python web frameworks — required
- Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL including query optimization, indexing, and schema design — required
- Hands-on experience with Redis for caching and queue management — required
- Experience building or integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, etc.) — required
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience — required

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
- Background in HR tech, ATS systems, or document processing pipelines
- Familiarity with Supabase or other BaaS platforms
- Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
- Strong communication skills — ability to write clear technical documentation

Technical Environment
- Python 3.12 + FastAPI + SQLAlchemy (async) + Alembic
- PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, Redis, Supabase Storage
- Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via LangChain
- Deployed on GCP; containerized with Docker

Compensation
- Salary: $130,000 – $180,000 depending on experience
- Location: Remote (US or India) with quarterly team offsites
- Equity + benefits package

Success Metrics (Year 1)
- Resume scoring pipeline processes 10,000+ resumes/day with <5% error rate
- API p99 latency < 200ms for all core endpoints
- Lead at least one major architectural improvement shipped to production
